parameters.formDescription: Submit organizational details, paste client needs assessment text, or enter engagement parameters.

values.placeholder: Paste complete client needs assessment form / questionnaire response here...
Client Organization Name (optional if specified in assessment)

nodes.name: User Proposal Form
nodes.notes: NODE 1: Proposal intake form supporting raw needs_assessment_text textarea input.

nodes.name: AI Extraction Node
nodes.notes: NODE 2: AI Unstructured Extractor using efficient gpt-4o-mini model. Extracts structured proposal fields from raw assessment text. Strictly avoids expensive reasoning models.

nodes.name: Parse AI Extraction
nodes.notes: NODE 3: Parses LLM structured JSON output, handles code fences, and normalizes fields.

nodes.name: Validate Extracted Intake
nodes.notes: NODE 4: Validates client_name, organization_description, client_challenges_summary, and approved_scope.

nodes.name: IF Intake Valid?
nodes.notes: Routes valid intakes to preview & human gate; halts invalid intakes with error.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Intake validation failed before Human Approval Gate.

nodes.name: Validation Error Response
nodes.notes: Returns validation diagnostic payload when required intake fields are missing.

nodes.name: Compute Approval Preview
nodes.notes: Computes 7-element Approval Preview Payload and calculates Sympl context quality score.

nodes.name: Human Approval Gate
nodes.notes: MANDATORY FIREWALL: Human approval gate displaying rich preview payload and context quality score.

nodes.name: Approval Decision Check
nodes.notes: Branches on human decision (APPROVE -> Prepare Payload; REJECT -> Rejection Response).

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Proposal generation rejected by human approver.

nodes.name: Proposal Generation Rejected
nodes.notes: Terminal rejection branch when approver rejects proposal generation.

nodes.name: Prepare Final Payload
nodes.notes: Combines enriched AI extraction with human approver scope decisions into final API payload.

nodes.name: Call Sympl Proposal RAG API
nodes.notes: NODE 5: Triggers async generation on Railway proposal backend (/api/v1/proposal/generate/async).

nodes.name: IF RAG Succeeded?
nodes.notes: Verifies backend returned valid job_id.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Sympl Proposal RAG API rejected submission.

nodes.name: RAG API Error Response
nodes.notes: Terminal error branch if proposal API call fails.

nodes.name: Store Job ID
nodes.notes: Initializes polling loop state.

nodes.name: Wait 5 Seconds
nodes.notes: Poll delay: 5 seconds between status checks.

nodes.name: Check Status API
nodes.notes: Polls GET /api/v1/proposal/status/{job_id}.

nodes.name: IF Completed?
nodes.notes: Exits loop when job reaches COMPLETED status.

nodes.name: Check Timeout Counter
nodes.notes: Increments poll counter; enforces 5-minute timeout ceiling.

nodes.name: IF Timeout?
nodes.notes: Routes to timeout error if ceiling reached; otherwise loops back to wait.

nodes.name: Poll Timeout Response
nodes.notes: Terminal error branch if generation times out.

nodes.name: Retrieve Generated PDF
nodes.notes: Downloads binary proposal.pdf.

nodes.name: Retrieve Manifest
nodes.notes: Downloads 5-artifact audit manifest.

nodes.name: Prepare Canva Import Handoff
nodes.notes: Prepares metadata for Canva import handoff.

nodes.name: CANVA IMPORT SERVICE
nodes.notes: Executes Canva asset import handoff.

nodes.name: Return Completion Result
nodes.notes: Workflow output: proposal URLs and delivery status.

meta.description: Production n8n workflow for Sympl Proposal RAG with AI Unstructured Intake Extraction (gpt-4o-mini), Schema Validation, Human Scope Approval Gate with Reviewer Preview, Asynchronous Polling Loop, PDF/Manifest Retrieval, and Canva Handoff.
